##### Project general facts

Azizi Wasel by Azizi Developments is a luxury waterfront high-rise with a fluid, organic exterior, where several tiers of balconies create a cascading effect. White curved forms are accentuated by subtle integrated lighting, giving the tower an elegant, sculptural look. The building rises above three basement levels and a ground floor to thirteen residential floors and a roof, offering studios and one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments, three- and four-bedroom penthouses and retail units.

Residents enjoy a swimming pool, a fully equipped gym, a sauna, a steam room and a shared jacuzzi for everyday wellness. A cinema, a game room, a multipurpose hall, a clubhouse, a barbecue area and indoor and outdoor children's play areas add variety, while cafes, restaurants and retail outlets bring convenience to the doorstep, complemented by accessible facilities, a welcoming lobby, lifts, parking and round-the-clock security with video surveillance.

Thoughtful interiors inspired by the beauty of the island combine sophistication, comfort and calm, with light palettes, quality finishes and generous windows that frame views of the sea and the city. Spacious balconies extend the living areas outdoors. Homes are delivered semi-furnished, with fitted kitchens and appliances and built-in wardrobes, leaving loose furniture to the owner's own taste and style.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Islands is a waterfront master community of five man-made islands off the coast of Deira, combining residential neighbourhoods, resorts, marinas and long stretches of public beach. Landscaped promenades, parks and cycling paths run along the shoreline, while hotels, beach clubs and waterfront dining venues give the islands a relaxed resort character close to the historic heart of the city.

The Infinity Bridge and Al Khaleej Road connect the islands with Deira, Bur Dubai and the city centre. The Waterfront Market is a short drive away, Port Rashid, Dubai Hospital and Dubai Frame are close by, and Dubai International Airport, City Centre Deira and Downtown Dubai are within comfortable driving distance, with schools, clinics and supermarkets serving families across the islands and in neighbouring Deira.

Dubai Islands is a freehold destination open to international buyers and one of the most actively developed waterfront areas in Dubai. Beach access, island living and proximity to the airport and the historic city centre attract both end users and investors. Strong demand for waterfront homes and holiday rentals supports attractive rental yields and long-term value for owners and investors alike.
